title: rosa dumalis f. kupcokii
intro: Rosa dumalis f. kupcokii, commonly known as the Rosa damascena var. kupcokii, is a fragrant flowering plant in the rose family. It has been traditionally used for its health benefits, including its antiseptic, anti-inflammatory, and antioxidant properties, which help to soothe skin irritations, reduce fever, and protect against cell damage. The therapeutic actions of Rosa dumalis f. kupcokii include its ability to calm the nervous system, reduce anxiety and stress, and promote a good night's sleep. Bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and essential oils, which contribute to its therapeutic properties.
